$comment: WHICH pack entries Synthea may calibrate, committed BEFORE the loader is built. A target list discovered during implementation is a target list shaped by what turned out to be easy. Fields absent here stay EXPERT_GUESS no matter what a Synthea run appears to say about them, and tests/test_synthea_targets.py enforces that.
$location: tests/eval/ with the other pre-registrations — pass_bars.json, v3_expected_shape.json, instrument_v2_gate.json. It lived in data/prior_packs/ for about four minutes, where available_packs() globs *.json and every pack load failed. A commitment is not data.

synthea_can_calibrate.stage: derived from condition onset and care-map progression
synthea_can_calibrate.comorbidities: co-occurrence is modelled by the care maps
synthea_can_calibrate.medication_ladder: medication assignment follows the care maps

synthea_cannot_calibrate.health_literacy: not modelled by Synthea at all
synthea_cannot_calibrate.base_adherence: Synthea does not simulate adherence behaviour
synthea_cannot_calibrate.dx_delay_months: care maps encode idealised pathways, not real-world delay
synthea_cannot_calibrate.social_determinants: Synthea's SDOH surface is thin and US-centric; transport, caregiver support and residence are the fields this product leans on hardest and the fields Synthea is weakest on

the_honest_post_synthea_state: a SPLIT pack. Clinical marginals Synthea-calibrated with a version and seed stamped; SDOH, literacy and adherence entries still EXPERT_GUESS, visibly. The pack listing shows precisely that split.
why_the_split_is_a_sharper_demo_line_not: 'clinical structure calibrated against a named synthetic population, social context declared as assumption' is more credible than uniform anything, because it tells a reviewer exactly where to push.

diff_before_adopt.rule: a Synthea-vs-current-prior table is REPORTED for every target entry before any value is adopted.
diff_before_adopt.why: the same reading discipline as every other migration in this repo. A ballpark that survives calibration is itself worth knowing, and a ballpark that does not is worth knowing louder.
diff_before_adopt.never: silently overwriting a prior with a calibrated value because the calibration exists.

reading_rule.why_now: one row of that table is going to be far from the current ballpark, and adopting everything is one command. Without this line written before the table exists, the biggest outlier gets adopted with the rest precisely because it is inconvenient to single out.
reading_rule.rule: a LARGE disagreement is INVESTIGATED BEFORE ADOPTED, never adopted because the calibration exists.
reading_rule.investigate_what: Synthea's care-map assumptions for that entry. Its documented US-centricity and pathway-shaping are exactly the kind of cause, and they are checkable rather than speculative.
reading_rule.adoption_may_be_DECLINED: per entry, with the reason recorded. The entry stays EXPERT_GUESS and is annotated 'Synthea disagrees, see note'.
reading_rule.the_distinction: the target list says what Synthea MAY calibrate. This rule says it does not get to AUTOMATICALLY.

provenance_stamp_required: synthea_version — Synthea is deterministic given (version, seed); a target that cannot name its run cannot be reproduced
quotability: UNCHANGED by any of this. SYNTHEA_CALIBRATED is not quotable. Only CUSTOMER_DATA_FITTED crosses that line, and that gate opens when a customer's own aggregates go through the calibration harness — a sales conversation, not a build item.

fixture_design.rule: fixtures must exercise the JOINS, not just the columns.
fixture_design.why: the structural diff catches schema drift. It cannot catch join-logic bugs that only appear under realistic cardinality — and join-by-a-key-that-is-not-unique has now appeared FOUR times in this repo. Synthea's CSVs join on PATIENT UUIDs across files, so the fixtures must make a positional or name-based join fail loudly IN THE FIXTURES, before the real run.
required_cases: a patient with MULTIPLE CONCURRENT conditions — the comorbidity join's real case
a medication with NO matching condition
duplicate-looking rows that are legitimately distinct encounters
two patients sharing a display name but not a UUID — a name-based join must break here

sample_size_discipline.problem: condition-conditional marginals are noisy at small n. Age-by-condition from 100 patients might rest on 12 diabetics, and a loader that smooths that silently is inventing precision.

two_runs.structural: ~100 patients. Validates that the fixtures match reality — columns, types, enum values. Feeds NO target.
two_runs.derivation: 1000+ patients, seeded. Feeds targets. Still minutes, not hours.

n_threshold.applies_to: the count of patients contributing to a given condition-conditional entry
n_threshold.below_it: the entry stays EXPERT_GUESS and is annotated 'Synthea n too small' — a THIRD visible state in the split pack, not a silent fallback
n_threshold.why_registered_now: this is pass-bars discipline applied to sample size. A threshold chosen after seeing which entries clear it is not a threshold.

deceased_patients.the_fact: `-p 100` counts LIVING patients. The structural run shipped 113, of which 13 are deceased.
deceased_patients.why_it_is_a_decision: prevalence-by-age shifts depending on the answer. Including the deceased weights the old tail with people who died of the conditions being modelled; excluding them models a population that never dies, which is also wrong.
deceased_patients.DECISION: EXCLUDE patients with a non-empty DEATHDATE from derivation.
deceased_patients.reason: the packs describe a population being RECRUITED INTO A TRIAL. A trial screens living candidates, so the marginals should describe living candidates. This is a product decision, not a statistical one, and it is the reason it can be made before seeing any number.
deceased_patients.consequence_accepted: the derived age marginal will be younger than a true prevalence-weighted one, because condition-related mortality is removed from the tail. Recorded here so the effect is a known property rather than a later surprise.
deceased_patients.the_loader_must: count and report how many patients it excluded, per run, in the diff table.

jar_pinning.rule: the Synthea jar is pinned by CONTENT, never by tag.
jar_pinning.why: `master-branch-latest` is a mutable pointer — the same lesson as pinning a model by digest rather than by tag. A jar that changes underneath the same URL changes every target derived from it.
jar_pinning.calibration_run_must: cite the same hash, or record that it used a different one and why. Download once, hash, record BEFORE generating.

medication_ladder_is_membership_not_orde.registered_before: the loader emits a single number
medication_ladder_is_membership_not_orde.the_distinction: every other calibratable entry is a MARGINAL. medication_ladder is a STRUCTURE — which drugs, in what escalation order, per condition.
medication_ladder_is_membership_not_orde.DECISION: Synthea may calibrate drug PREVALENCE per condition. It may NOT calibrate ladder ORDER. The ladder stays EXPERT_GUESS, annotated 'Synthea informs membership, not order'.
medication_ladder_is_membership_not_orde.reason_1_the_data: dispenses carry START dates, so a temporal sequence is technically recoverable per patient. Recovering a canonical ladder from those sequences is a much stronger claim than counting membership.
medication_ladder_is_membership_not_orde.reason_2_the_sharper_one: the order is Synthea's PROTOCOL ASSUMPTION, not a population fact. Its care maps encode a US clinical escalation pathway and then emit dispenses consistent with it. Calibrating a ladder against that output would re-derive Synthea's own protocol logic and stamp it SYNTHEA_CALIBRATED — a care-map decision wearing a data label. Prevalence is a count of what the simulated population received; order is a restatement of the rule that generated them.
medication_ladder_is_membership_not_orde.if_this_is_revisited: ladder order needs its own justification and its own provenance kind, not an extension of this one.

condition_mapping.problem: Synthea's condition vocabulary is GRANULAR — 'Diabetes mellitus type 2 (disorder)' plus complications as separate rows — and the packs are COARSE, five conditions. Mapping is lossy by construction.
requirements: an EXPLICIT code -> pack-condition table, committed, never inferred from description substrings at runtime
a per-run report of UNMAPPED condition rows: how many matched no pack condition, and the top unmapped codes by frequency
condition_mapping.why_the_report_is_the_important_half: a mapping that quietly drops 60% of condition rows produces clean-looking marginals from a population fragment. Same species as the deceased count: exclusions are visible, always, and a derivation that cannot say what it discarded is not auditable.
condition_mapping.no_threshold_yet: what fraction of unmapped rows is acceptable is NOT registered here, because it depends on what the codes turn out to be — complications of a mapped condition are a different loss from unrelated conditions. The report comes first, the threshold after reading it, and that ordering is stated so the threshold cannot be chosen to fit.

calibration_run_parameters.registered_before: the loader can compute a single target
calibration_run_parameters.why_committed_now: pass-bars discipline applied to data generation. Nobody gets to size the population after seeing which entries almost clear the threshold, and nobody gets to reroll the seed after an inconvenient draw.
calibration_run_parameters.deceased: excluded from derivation, counted and reported — see deceased_patients
calibration_run_parameters.manifest_required: the calibration export ships its own MANIFEST citing these parameters and the jar hash it actually used.

PRE_RUN_FINDING_prevalence_is_the_bindin.found_before: the calibration run, and before the loader emitted any number
PRE_RUN_FINDING_prevalence_is_the_bindin.status: REPORTED, NOT ACTED ON. calibration_run_parameters is unchanged pending an explicit amendment — the parameters were registered hours ago and editing them on the strength of a convenient discovery is the thing pre-registration exists to prevent.
PRE_RUN_FINDING_prevalence_is_the_bindin.measured_on: the structural export: 113 patients, 100 living, 4,207 condition rows, 187 distinct codes

heart failure.note: one CHF patient in 113, and they are deceased — so zero LIVING, under the registered exclusion Same shape as RA once the deceased exclusion applies: rare and remitting-or-fatal, not absent.

rheumatoid arthritis.note: 0 living in 113 — EXPECTED. Synthea models RA at ~1% lifetime incidence with ~75% remission under DMARDs, so ~0.25% live with active disease. See CORRECTION_2026_08_27: the earlier 'not modelled' reading was wrong.

PRE_RUN_FINDING_prevalence_is_the_bindin.consequence_1: the registered `-p 1000` clears the n=50 threshold for type 2 diabetes ONLY. Breast cancer needs ~1,700, COPD ~2,500, heart failure far more.
PRE_RUN_FINDING_prevalence_is_the_bindin.consequence_2: rheumatoid arthritis may have no Synthea path at all. If Synthea has no RA module, that pack stays entirely EXPERT_GUESS regardless of population size — which is a fact about the tool, not a failure of the loader, and belongs in the split-pack story rather than being worked around.
PRE_RUN_FINDING_prevalence_is_the_bindin.what_this_does_NOT_change: the n-threshold of 50. Lowering it because the conditions are rare would be choosing a bar to fit the data, which is precisely the move the threshold was registered early to block.
PRE_RUN_FINDING_prevalence_is_the_bindin.the_decision_this_needs: an amendment to calibration_run_parameters naming a larger population, and an explicit finding on whether Synthea models RA at all. Both belong to the owner, before the run.

CORRECTION_2026_08_27.what_was_wrong: the finding read RA's absence as a MODELLING LIMIT — 'the string rheumatoid does not appear', therefore possibly no module. That inference was wrong.
CORRECTION_2026_08_27.what_is_true: Synthea DOES model rheumatoid arthritis: ~1% lifetime incidence, and ~75% of cases REMIT under DMARDs, so roughly 0.25% of the population is living with active RA. Zero-in-113 was the expectation, not an absence.
CORRECTION_2026_08_27.how_it_was_settled: module inspection against the same pinned jar, not by argument.
CORRECTION_2026_08_27.the_reclassification: RA is not a tool limit. It is the EXTREME CASE of the prevalence problem, with a module-level mechanism behind it — and heart failure has the same shape once the deceased exclusion applies.
CORRECTION_2026_08_27.the_consequence_that_matters: flat sampling cannot reach the rarer packs at any practical population size. Even -p 5000 expects ~12 active RA patients, below the n=50 threshold. This is now a measured fact with a mechanism, not a sample-size guess.

keep_run_supplement.status: AMENDMENT — registered before the run it governs, and before any target exists. Legal on the same terms as the E-/J- namespace amendment before v3 recorded: the window closes at first record, not at first registration.
amending_evidence: the prevalence table measured on the structural export
module inspection showing RA is modelled at ~1% incidence with ~75% remission
keep_run_supplement.nothing_is_replaced: the registered `-p 1000, seed 20260827` flat run EXECUTES AS WRITTEN. It validates the pipeline end to end, feeds type 2 diabetes — the one condition it covers — and produces the unmapped-code report at scale. One thing visibly grows; nothing silently moves.

the_supplement.mechanism: `-k keepMatchingPatientsPath` — Synthea generates until N patients match a criteria module. This is REJECTION SAMPLING from the same generative process, so it is unbiased for CONDITION-CONDITIONAL marginals.
the_supplement.why_that_is_the_right_object: each pack describes people WITH the condition. A giant flat run would be filtered down to condition patients anyway; keep-runs arrive there directly, without generating millions of irrelevant patients.
the_supplement.why_60: buffer over the registered n=50 threshold, so the deceased exclusion and any active-condition filter can remove patients without silently dropping the entry below its bar.
the_supplement.seeds: derived per condition from the registered master seed 20260827, not chosen freely
the_supplement.jar: 018ad7f04f7aacb995804d7d4781c76d5fc714f7f23257ba50daa9eefae224ac — the same hash, or the run records why not

matched_is_a_definition.rule: keep-module criteria are COMMITTED per condition, in data/synthea/keep_modules/*.json.
matched_is_a_definition.criterion: an ACTIVE (unstopped) condition carrying a named SNOMED code.
matched_is_a_definition.what_still_applies_afterwards: keep-run patients are conditioned on EVER matching. The deceased filter and every derivation filter run AFTER selection — the module selects a candidate pool, it does not pre-approve one.
matched_is_a_definition.unverified: the modules are authored from the documented format and have never been executed. The first run is their structural diff, and the same verdict applies: if the run contradicts a module, the module was the bug. The RA code 69896004 is the least verified thing here — if that keep-run yields nothing, the code is the first suspect, not the prevalence.

sdoh_findings_deferred.decision: DEFER. No amendment to the target list.
sdoh_findings_deferred.the_discovery: Synthea's conditions.csv carries SDOH as condition findings — full-time employment (318 rows), social isolation (130), limited social contact (110), higher education (51), intimate partner abuse (91).
sdoh_findings_deferred.reason_1: amending a target list after seeing what happens to be available is the trap the list was committed early to avoid.
sdoh_findings_deferred.reason_2: these are MODULE OUTPUTS — the medication-ladder argument verbatim. A US social-assumption wearing a data label.
sdoh_findings_deferred.reason_3_the_decisive_one: the semantic mapping is poor exactly where the product needs it. Employment maps loosely; TRANSPORT, CAREGIVER SUPPORT and HEALTH LITERACY — the barrier-generating fields — are absent from all 187 codes. So even a future adoption would calibrate the fields that matter least.
sdoh_findings_deferred.when_revisited: as its own registered decision, written before any derivation touches these fields.
